b13/ai-label.description: Name typo3/fluid-styled-content as an optional set dependency: the hard one made TYPO3 log "Invalid set b13/ai-label: Missing dependency" on every boot of a site without fluid_styled_content

lochmueller/index.description: Bootstrap Package indexing: read an item's or element's field only where the record's type has it; Record::get() throws for a field outside the type (a carousel item of type "header" has no bodytext, one of type "image" no subheader), and the throw dropped the whole page from the index

mfd/ai-filemetadata.description: Import ApplicationType from TYPO3\CMS\Core\Http (1.6.3+ imports a class that does not exist) and skip the frontend check when there is no request, as on the CLI; a failed generation is logged as a warning instead of failing the upload
FalAdapter::localizeFile(): log DataHandler errors as a warning instead of DebuggerUtility::var_dump(), which wrote HTML into the AJAX upload response; the exception stays

typo3/cms-backend.description: Element information of a record that does not exist (deleted, or a stale link) showed an info message for pages but threw a TypeError for every other table: getRecordWSOL() returns null and the controller's $row is typed array

thieleundklose/autotranslate.description: Local translator hook: route translations through a container-resolved \DeepL\Translator subclass (nr-llm bridge) instead of the DeepL client
